purpose: Teach: ヒール/ハザード/聖職/刺繍/中心地/辿っ/オートバイ/マンゴー

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、お客様、本気で、絶対、ハイヒール、絶対、履いて、絶対、来られる方、増えてるな、葵で
lines.en: Aoi, you know—more and more customers are showing up in heels. It's amazing.
lines.style: Warm, expansive Kansai energy. Opens with genuine observation. Speaks with admiration and ease. Leans forward slightly, naturally emphatic without forcing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。お客様の車、本気で、絶対、ハザードランプ、絶対、付けて、絶対、停車されている時、葵で、絶対、お声、本気で、絶対、かけております、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, it's true. Even when customers park with their hazard lights on, I always make sure to call out and greet them.
lines.style: Bright and attentive. Each phrase lands with quiet pride. Not boasting—stating a fact about care she gives naturally. Warm professional warmth.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、聖職者の方、絶対、お客様として、絶対、葵に、絶対、来てくださってるんやで、葵さん、本気で、感謝
lines.en: You know, priests and clergy members come by as customers. I'm really grateful for that, Aoi. Truly.
lines.style: Slows down noticeably. Genuine weight behind the words. Daichi's usual loudness softens into sincerity. Speaks like he's recognizing something sacred without naming it directly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。新メニューの皿、本気で、絶対、刺繍風の、絶対、デザイン、葵で、絶対、お洒落になりますね
lines.en: Yes. The new menu plates—the embroidery-style design is going to look so lovely.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy. Aoi's voice settles into admiration. Speaks as though picturing the plates before her. Gentle pace, genuine warmth about small details.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、本気で、絶対、街の中心地に、絶対、二号店、絶対、出す野心、絶対、捨てへんで、本気で、絶対、頑張ろうな
lines.en: Aoi, I haven't given up on this dream—opening a second location right in the heart of the city. We're going to make it happen.
lines.style: Earnest and determined. Daichi's volume steadies into conviction. Speaks with the warmth of someone sharing a real dream with someone he trusts. Direct eye contact level in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。創業からの、本気で、絶対、葵で、絶対、お客様、絶対、辿ってきた道、絶対、本気で、感謝、しております
lines.en: Yes. Since we first opened, I'm grateful for every customer who's walked through that door. Every single one.
lines.style: Contemplative and grounded. Aoi's voice holds quiet reverence. Speaks slowly, as if reviewing a long path she's traveled. Genuine gratitude, not performed.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お客さん、本気で、絶対、オートバイで、絶対、来られる方、絶対、葵で、駐輪スペース、本気で、絶対、用意したいで、葵さん
lines.en: You know, more customers are coming by motorcycle now. I want to set up proper parking space for them, Aoi.
lines.style: Animated and practical. Daichi's energy returns but focused. Speaks with the excitement of someone solving a problem. Direct, generous, naturally emphatic.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。夏のスイーツに、本気で、絶対、マンゴー、絶対、ふんだんに、絶対、使いたいですね、葵で
lines.en: Yes. For the summer sweets menu, I'd really love to use lots of fresh mango. It would be so good.
lines.style: Warm and visionary. Aoi's voice softens with genuine enthusiasm about the details she cares for. Speaks like someone already tasting the possibility. Tender closing.
